Elena (Finance): FYI ClearLake flagged a strange credit followed by a reversal on their May statement. Can billing ops investigate?
Pri (Acct Mgmt): I pulled INV-2026-2120. There's a line: MAN-REFUND $2,450 on 05/09 then a reversal line REV-MAN-0509 -$2,450 on 05/10. Customer says they never asked for a reversal.
Jon (Billing Ops): Hm. Our notes show we issued a manual refund after a support escalation (ticket #SUP-9812). Looking at automation: nightly AR-cleaner runs that reconcile stale refunds. Maybe it detected "outstanding-refund" and auto-reversed because it thought it was duplicate.
Jon (Billing Ops): Snippet from ops logs:
```
2026-05-09T22:14:03Z billing manual_credit acct=clr-101 invoice=INV-2026-2120 amt=2450 code=MAN-REFUND ref=SUP-9812
2026-05-10T02:03:10Z ar-cleaner acct=clr-101 detect=refund_stale action=auto_reversal id=REV-MAN-0509 amt=2450 reason=stale-refund
```
Pri (Acct Mgmt): So the cleaner thought the refund was stale (maybe timing with invoice window) and auto-reversed it. Customer sees credit then charge. Not great.
Elena (Finance): Policy: if a system reversal cancels a valid manual refund for a customer-requested issue, we should re-apply the refund as a manual goodwill adjustment and mark the automation rule for exclusion. Create credit of $2,450 and add rc=ar-cleaner-false-positive.
Jon (Billing Ops): Queuing manual credit: `vb credit --acct clr-101 --amount 2450 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-2120 --code GW-REF-0509 --note "reapply refund after auto-reversal (ar-cleaner false positive)"`
ops-bot: Action queued: manual_credit_pending | id=BILL-9344 | acct=clr-101 | amt=2450 USD
Pri (Acct Mgmt): I'll message the customer first: short apology + confirm we'll re-post the credit and that the reversal was a system mistake.
Pri (Acct Mgmt): Draft: "Hi ClearLake 99999999 we investigated INV-2026-2120. A manual refund was issued for your support case but an automated reconciliation job incorrectly reversed it. We've re-applied the $2,450 credit (txn CR-2026-551F) and disabled the AR-cleaner rule for your account while we sort the rule. Sorry for the confusion. 9999999999999999999"
Jon (Billing Ops): Credit posted txn CR-2026-551F. ops-bot: Action completed: manual_credit | id=BILL-9344 | status=completed | txn=CR-2026-551F
Elena (Finance): Please add a mitigation card: update AR-cleaner logic to skip accounts with recent manual_credit ref tags and add a dry-run alert. Tag rc=ar-cleaner-false-positive.
Pri (Acct Mgmt): Customer replied: "Thanks, that clears it up. Appreciate the quick fix." :thumbsup
Elena (Finance): Closing from finance side after ledger reconciliation. Jon, file the change in billing runbook.
